title: Catch the Babies
hook: 双胞胎宝宝一出门就到处乱爬，全家总动员追着他们去农场、花园和黏黏泉。

cells.en: Dora's whole family is in the living room together.
cells.cn: Dora 一家人全都在客厅里。

cells.en: Map shows the way: farm, garden, gooey geyser.
cells.cn: 地图指路：农场、花园，再到黏黏泉。

cells.en: Everyone runs after the babies on the path.
cells.cn: 大家在小路上追着宝宝们跑。

cells.en: There are big watermelons in the wooden box.
Grandma and Grandpa run with Dora and Boots.
cells.cn: 爷爷奶奶跟着 Dora 和 Boots 一起跑。

cells.en: Three purple flowers smile and sing in the garden.
cells.cn: 花园里三朵紫色的花笑着唱歌。

cells.en: The family calls together, “Map, Map, Map!”
cells.cn: 一家人一起喊：“地图，地图，地图！”

cells.en: They push through the green leaves and shout, “Louder!”
cells.cn: 他们钻过绿叶，大声喊：“再大声点！”

cells.en: The gooey geyser sprays bubbles, not sticky goo.
cells.cn: 黏黏泉喷出来的是泡泡，不是黏胶。

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Catch the Babies”.
ending: In the end, the family catches the babies and the geyser sprays bubbles. My favorite part is ______.
